entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers. Flurries are possible about the road from around dawn Tuesday onwards but snow is not expected to settle on the road. However, from late afternoon 1 or 2 cm could accumulate above 800 metres, and about 1 cm is possible down to 500 metres.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers lowering to 400 metres initially and to 200 metres by evening. Accumulations of 1 to 2 cm are possible above 400 metres. A few flurries down to 200 metres but not expected to accumulate.
